note: The citing work names Sullivan et al. (2003) / DynamoRIO specifically as the pioneer of the meta-tracing concept ('was pioneered by Sullivan et al. (2003) in DynamoRIO'), which is a central design idea of Pycket, and then positions Pycket's differences against the broader class of tracing systems including that work.
title: Pycket: a tracing JIT for a functional language
